statement.p: (a) Find a unit vector from the point P=(3,1) and toward the point Q=(15,6).
(b) Find a vector of length 39 pointing in the same direction.

static.solution:
(a) The displacement from P to Q is given by \overrightarrow{PQ} = (15\,\vec i + 6\,\vec j) - (3\,\vec i + 1\,\vec j) = 12\,\mathit{\vec i}+5\,\mathit{\vec j}. Since \mbox{len}{\overrightarrow{PQ}} = \sqrt{12^2 + 5^2} = 13, a unit vector \vec u in the direction of \overrightarrow{PQ} is given by \vec u = \frac{1}{13}\,\overrightarrow{PQ} = \frac{1}{13}\,(12\,\mathit{\vec i}+5\,\mathit{\vec j}) .
(b) A vector of length 39 pointing in the same direction is given by 39\,\vec u = \frac{39}{13}\,(12\,\mathit{\vec i}+5\,\mathit{\vec j}) = 36\,\mathit{\vec i}+15\,\mathit{\vec j}.
